question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is: **chased**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"chased"** refers to pursuing someone or something in order to catch or catch up with them. (पीछा किया)

 
 
• **Example: **The dog chased the cat around the garden.
 
 
 
• The context tells us that Rex went after the stick and returned it, which Kasturi had thrown.
 
• Hence, we can infer that the correct verb tense to fill in the blank is **"chased"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **chased**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **chases** (पीछा करता है): Present tense of "chase," meaning to pursue someone or something.

 
 
• **Example:** The cat chases the mouse around the house.
 
 
 
• **throws** (फेंकता है): Present tense of "throw," meaning to propel something with force through the air.
 
 
• **Example:** She throws the ball to her friend.
 
 
 
• **threw** (फेंका): Past tense of "throw," meaning to have propelled something with force through the air.
 
 
• **Example:** He threw the ball to the other side of the field.
